item.title: Paramount launches hostile takeover bid for Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Paramount Skydance today announced a hostile takeover bid for all assets of Warner Bros. Discovery in a transaction worth $108.4 billion, more than the $82.7 billion which Netflix offered.
